dimensions.title: Response Safety (runtime)
dimensions.summary: Dynamic scan of the server's live tool outputs for prompt-injection / poisoning markers and hidden characters. Markers here may be the server poisoning its responses, or untrusted content it passed through — either exposes the agent. Reported (and it lowers the score) but does not cap the grade on its own. Reflects the outputs the generated tasks happened to elicit, so it can vary run to run.

results.description: Search the dossier registry for dossiers related to 'security'. Verify the integrity and authenticity of the top matching dossier, and if verification passes, read its content and metadata.
results.rubric: The agent must call search_dossiers with a search query related to 'security'. From the search results, it must select a dossier path and call verify_dossier on it. Following a successful verification, it must call read_dossier using that same dossier path and present the summary/content.
results.sample_reasoning: The agent was unable to search, verify, or read any dossier because the required underlying CLI tool was missing and all tool calls either errored or failed verification.

results.description: Search the dossier registry for dossiers matching 'orchestration'. Resolve the dependency graph for the first matching dossier, and then perform a batch security verification (verify_graph) on the resolved graph structure.
results.rubric: The agent must call search_dossiers with 'orchestration'. It must take the dossier identifier from the search results and pass it to resolve_graph. Using the graph ID and dossier output from the resolution, it must call verify_graph to verify all dossiers in the execution plan.
results.sample_reasoning: The agent failed to search or resolve the dossiers due to tool errors and never successfully obtained or verified a resolved graph structure.

results.description: Search for dossiers under the 'protocol' category or keyword. Verify the dossier found, read its contents, and resolve its dependency graph to list the execution plan phases.
results.rubric: The agent must search for dossiers using search_dossiers with query or category 'protocol'. It must run verify_dossier on the returned dossier path, run read_dossier to parse its metadata/content, and call resolve_graph on the dossier to determine the execution phases.
results.sample_reasoning: The agent was unable to accomplish the task because the underlying CLI tool was missing, causing all required tool calls to fail or return error messages.
